findings.issue_summary: Manual Sharing: Policy Exempt. User triggers transfer to 3P; no disclosure or declaration needed.
findings.evidence: User files, app logs, and device reports are processed locally and only shared off-device or transferred to remote storage when explicitly initiated by the user via Android Share Sheet (Intent.ACTION_SEND) or user-configured SMB/WebDAV connections (AppLogActivity.kt line 46, DeviceReportActivity.kt lines 354 & 381, FileManagerActivity.kt lines 691 & 1043).
findings.recommendation: No prominent in-app disclosure is required for user-initiated file sharing or manual uploads to user-configured endpoints (Case 4). Ensure any manual first-party storage features are declared in the Play Store Data Safety form if required.

findings.issue_summary: Manual Sharing: Policy Exempt. User triggers transfer to 3P; no disclosure or declaration needed.
findings.evidence: Performance and diagnostic metrics (logcat logs, battery health, voltage, temperature, battery drain stats) are sampled and processed locally on device (BatteryHealth.kt, BatteryMonitorActivity.kt line 85, AppLogActivity.kt line 230). Data is only exported off-device when explicitly shared by the user via Intent.ACTION_SEND in ToolActivity.
findings.recommendation: No prominent disclosure is required as diagnostic data collection is local and off-device transmission is strictly user-initiated via Share Sheet (Case 4).
